title: Zu Hülfe! zu Hülfe!
subtitle: Tamino and the three Ladies: from the Introduction of Die Zauberflöte, Act 1 (No. 1)

passages.label: Tamino: Zu Hülfe! zu Hülfe! · barmherzige Götter! · ach rettet mich, ach schützet mich!
The Ladies: Stirb, Ungeheu'r! · Triumph! · durch unsres Armes Tapferkeit
Ein holder Jüngling · Würd' ich mein Herz der Liebe weih'n · Lasst uns zu unsrer Fürstin eilen
So geht und sagt es ihr · Ich bleibe, ich wache, ich schütze (to the fermata)

licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by two independent readers, with a judge settling every difference and a sweep for the marks, then a fresh check until clean; every bar of every part adds up. The Italian translation, the notes printed only for it (extra eighths, split quarters, down-stem notes and whole notes beside the German notes), and the stage directions are left out. Where the print puts two Ladies on one staff, each Lady has her own line here. Tamino sings until he faints (bar 40); the Ladies sing from bar 40. The section ends at the fermata and double bar at the end of p. 15, before “Ich sollte fort?”. Playback tempo from complete recordings: the median length of this section, 3:38, from Haitink 1981 (3:34) and Norrington with the London Classical Players (3:15), whose tracks split the Introduction at “Ich sollte fort?”, and Klemperer 1964, Böhm 1964 and Christie 1995, whose No. 1 tracks (6:53, 6:44, 6:40) were given this section's mean share of the Introduction in the first two (54.5%).
